skip.source_cn: 斯莱泽的种种行为都指向了同一种可能：班题斯打算趁虚而入，入侵诺珐斯。为了保护这座城市，你决定联络博闻广识的佐尔娅，想办法唤醒并治好苔佩希。

en.text: Salazer's actions point to one possibility: Bantus intends to exploit Novaris's weakness and invade. To protect the city, you contact the knowledgeable Zorya for a way to wake and heal Tephesia.
